about: Aurora is a town in York Region, on Yonge Street north of Richmond Hill and south of Newmarket. It has a preserved 19th-century downtown, GO Transit service, and suburban neighbourhoods that filled in around the historic core. Sheppard’s Bush and other conservation pockets sit among the streets. About 62,000 people live in Aurora.
